content.rendered:
Maple 15W Wireless Charger & USB Hub With Pen Stand – Premium Bamboo Desk Organizer

Upgrade your workspace with the Maple 15W Wireless Charger & USB Hub With Pen Stand, a smart and eco-friendly solution designed for modern offices, corporate gifting, and home desks. Crafted from natural bamboo, this bamboo charger seamlessly combines wireless charging, multi-device connectivity, and desk organization into one elegant accessory. Its minimalist design enhances productivity while adding a premium, sustainable touch to your workstation.

The integrated 1*15W wireless charger delivers fast and efficient power to compatible smartphones, ensuring clutter-free charging without tangled cables. Simply place your device on the charging pad and enjoy reliable performance throughout the day. Whether used at workstations, conference rooms, or reception desks, this wireless charging stand is engineered for convenience and durability.

In addition to wireless charging, the product features a 4* USB hub 2.0 output 2A max, allowing you to connect and power multiple devices simultaneously. From keyboards and mice to flash drives and other peripherals, the USB hub ensures smooth data transfer and dependable power output. With an Input: 5V/2A, the device maintains stable performance across all connected accessories.

The built-in pen stand keeps your essentials organized and within easy reach. Ideal for pens, styluses, or small stationery items, it helps maintain a tidy desk environment while improving workflow efficiency. This multifunctional design makes it a perfect fit for professionals, executives, and remote workers who value both aesthetics and utility.

Key Features

  • Premium bamboo charger with natural, eco-friendly finish
  • High-speed 1*15W wireless charger for compatible smartphones
  • Integrated 4* USB hub 2.0 output 2A max for multiple devices
  • Stable power supply with Input: 5V/2A
  • Functional pen stand for desk organization
  • Compact, space-saving design ideal for office and home use
  • Perfect for corporate gifts, employee joining kits, and promotional branding

Designed with sustainability in mind, this bamboo wireless charging station aligns with the growing demand for eco-conscious office accessories. Bamboo is not only renewable and durable but also adds a warm, professional look to any desk setup. This makes the product highly suitable for brands looking to promote green initiatives through premium corporate merchandise.

The is also an excellent choice for bulk orders and customized branding. Logos can be elegantly added to the bamboo surface, making it an impactful corporate gift for clients, employees, and business partners. Its daily usability ensures long-term brand visibility while delivering real value to the end user.

Whether you are setting up a smart office, upgrading employee workstations, or sourcing high-quality corporate gifts, this bamboo charging hub offers the perfect balance of technology, design, and sustainability. With wireless charging, multiple USB outputs, and a practical pen holder, it addresses everyday desk needs in one refined product.

Choose the to enhance productivity, reduce cable clutter, and elevate desk aesthetics. Its versatile functionality and premium bamboo construction make it a standout accessory in today’s connected work environment.
